zh-Hans: 请打开原有 RPG Maker MV 工程，选择 www 下的 RPG Maker MV，确认选择完成后返回工作台，再点试玩。留意是否进入标题画面，以及能否开始游戏并载入地图。
en-US: Open an existing RPG Maker MV project, select RPG Maker MV under www, and check that the workbench returns after saving. Choose Play and check the title screen, starting a game, and loading a map.
